sets.title: Neverball Easy
sets.description:
Difficulty: Beginner through Intermediate

25 levels with a smooth learning curve.
Read level introductions for gameplay tips.

sets.title: Neverball Medium
sets.description:
Difficulty: Beginner through Expert

25 levels which provide a balanced
challenge for players. Try to claim
some of the records provided.

sets.title: Neverball Hard
sets.description:
Difficulty: Intermediate through Expert

25 levels with more of a challenge for
the experienced player. Try to claim
Best Times, Most Coins, and Fast Unlock records.

sets.title: Tour de force
sets.description:
Difficulty: Expert through Insane

25 levels with even greater challenge.
Author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod (mym)

sets.title: Retour de force
sets.description:
Difficulty: A little bit harder than my first set.

More challenge, particularly for grabbing coins.
Author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod (mym)

sets.title: Nevermania
sets.description:
Difficulty: Expert through Impossible

Assorted levels for advanced players.
Author: Florian Priester

sets.title: Tones Levels
sets.description:
Difficulty: Moderate to Difficult.

Author: Ian Walker

levels.title: easy
levels.message:
Move the mouse to tilt the floor.
Collect 10 coins to unlock the goal.
Guide the ball to the goal to
finish the level.

Click to begin.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: peasy
levels.message:
Mouse buttons rotate the view.
Press Escape to pause or quit.



Click to begin.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: coins
levels.message:
This time you must get 50 coins to unlock the goal.
Red coins are worth 5, blue coins are worth 10.
Get to the goal before time expires!

Click to begin.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: fence
levels.message:
''Flat'' is relative.
Learn to hold the floor at an angle
so that a slope remains level.
This way, you maintain full control of the ball.
Use momentum to get up to the big coins.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: groundbreak
levels.message:
Getting to the goal
shouldn't be a problem,
but getting all of the coins will
require some planning.

Hint: often it is faster to avoid
a hole instead of falling into it.
levels.author: Janis Rucis

levels.title: goals
levels.message:
There are 100 coins here.
This one shouldn't be too difficult,
if you don't accidentally make a goal first.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: goslow
levels.message:
Tilt the floor as little as possible.
Less tilt means lower speed.
Lower speed means better control.
Watch the clock and use the time wisely.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: slightcurve
levels.message:
Hills require more speed to get over.
Be careful not to go too fast!
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: slalom
levels.message:
Follow the trail of coins to reach the goal.
If you hit a post while moving quickly,
you will bounce far off course.
levels.author: Jean Privat

levels.title: lollipop
levels.message:
Follow the yellow lick road!

The blue coins are especially challenging,
but with some experimentation and practice,
you'll be able to collect them all.
levels.author: David Olsen

levels.title: bumper
levels.message:
Try to avoid being hit by moving objects.
One bump can throw the ball
completely out of control.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: hole
levels.message:
Stay away from the edges!
When approaching a drop, begin slowing down
early. You need just as much room to slow
down as you did to speed up.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: speedbumps
levels.message:
When the ball is on a moving platform,
it will be pulled in the direction of movement.
Use the rails to steady yourself,
and collect the coins you need
to open the goal.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: roundlaby
levels.message:
There is only one path to reach the goal,
but lots of paths for collecting coins.
Make sure you collect enough
to unlock the goal.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: thwomp2
levels.message:
Grab all the coins...
but don't get bullied!
levels.author: Paul Tompkins

levels.title: easyhalfpipe
levels.message:
Half-pipes can be fun,
but they make it easy to fall out.
Don't over accelerate and you will
be able to stay in control.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: roundcoins
levels.message:
When you are on the elevators,
make small adjustments to keep the ball steady.
You can collect many coins by
keeping the ball in one place.
Too much movement and you will fall off.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: corners
levels.message:
Here are some more opportunities for you to
fall off into the void. Hit the bump hard to
grab some big coins and score a short time.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: greed
levels.message:
Each bridge is narrower than the one before.
But each pays better than the last as well!
You get to decide how far you go on this one.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: wakka
levels.message:
Here's another coin grab.
Perhaps you already know a good route.
Teleportation might come in handy.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: maze
levels.message:
The ball wants to rebound uncontrollably
in a narrow passage. Keep it slow and
off the walls. All the coins are collectable
in the given time.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: curved
levels.message:
As before, but without the training wheels.
Keep the ball on a level floor
and maintain precise control.
Build some momentum to reach the corners.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: mover
levels.message:
A moving platform can be tricky.
Use precise timing to get aboard,
and precise balance to stay there.
Don't let it move out from under you.
Ride the platforms to grab the big coins.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: bumps
levels.message:
Learn to control a bouncing ball.
Look at the shadow to know where the
ball will land.  If you're feeling confident in
your mastery of bouncing, take a risk
for a big payoff.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: mazebump
levels.message:
Puzzling but profitable.

Take time to observe the motions
of the bumpers - it will help you
to reach the goal.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: locks
levels.message: Hit the switches to move the barriers.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: multicurves
levels.message:
The temptation to move quickly
could prove your undoing.

Then again, maybe not...
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: accordian
levels.message: Stairway to heaven
levels.author: Ian Walker

levels.title: zigzag
levels.message:
There are plenty of coins here if you're
willing to take the time to grab them.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: roundfloors
levels.message:
This wedding cake is plenty rich,
but be careful as you go
to each lower layer.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: four
levels.message: Balance risk versus reward.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: hardrise
levels.message:
Ascend the slope to reach your goal.
(Easier said than done.)
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: easytele
levels.message:
Use teleporters to go
where you otherwise couldn't.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: cross
levels.message:
Use momentum to reach
the upper platforms,
but keep the ball in control
for safe landing.

The manual view may help here.
levels.author: Jānis Rūcis

levels.title: sparselines
levels.message:
Bump the logs at speed to change lanes.
Try to reach the top for an extra challenge!
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: qbert
levels.message: You can never go home again...
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: stairs
levels.message:
Here's yet another test of your ability
to control bouncing.  Moving down the
stairs too quickly can be hazardous.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: drops
levels.message:
Remember to keep an eye on the shadow to
help control a bouncing ball.  And don't
forget to use the mouse buttons to keep the
ball in view.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: telemaze
levels.message:
This maze has no walls.
But that doesn't make the solution
any easier to find.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: learngrow
levels.message:
The ball will fit in those small holes,
if you can just find something to make it smaller.
Other places may require a bigger ball.
One thing is certain - you'll want a plan!
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: spiraldn
levels.message:
Take it slow to keep it away from the edge.
Or, don't.
Either way might work.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: timer
levels.message:
That one switch controls all five barriers.
Be quick, because the switch is on a timer.
When it expires, the barriers will rise.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: spiralup
levels.message:
Just as before, but moving up instead of down.
No cheating this time.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: angle
levels.message:
Those bridges are angled.
Each is narrower and steeper than the last.
Take the easy cash or
go all the way for a big payoff.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: coneskeleton
levels.message:
Plenty of coins for the taking.
Can you take them all?
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: rampdn
levels.message:
You'll need to exert some control over your
view here.  Press 3 to stop the auto-rotation.
Use the mouse buttons to rotate it manually.
Press 1 to return to the auto-rotating view.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: islands
levels.message: Catch the train before it leaves the station.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: plinko
levels.message: Take it slowly.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: title
levels.message:
Neverball

http://neverball.org

Created by Robert Kooima
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: woodmaze
levels.message:
Follow the trail of coins
to make it through the labyrinth.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: grid
levels.message:
Yes, the ball does fit quite nicely through
those little holes.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: risers
levels.message:
Ride the elevators to the top.
They move quickly,
so don't dally too long.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: curbs
levels.message:
To make progress here you'll need to hit the
edges hard and control your bouncing.
It's often easiest to hit the curb at a corner.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: hump
levels.message: Momentum may work against you.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: pyramid
levels.message:
You'll only get about 15 seconds at each step,
so don't delay.  Get the coins and
get to the next switch.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: rampup
levels.message:
I think I can.
I think I can.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: check
levels.message:
There's not enough floor here.
Hopefully that's not a problem.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: tilt
levels.message: The floor is as flat as you make it.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: sync
levels.message:
Use the switches to set the platforms
in motion.  Time it so they come
together in the middle.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: nostairs
levels.message:
There are two goals here.
You can complete this level
the easy way or the hard way.
Of course, by going the easy way
you can forget about all
those red and blue coins.
levels.author: Jānis Rūcis

levels.title: frogger
levels.message: Ribbit!
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: quads
levels.message: Don't get bullied.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: teleport
levels.message:
The ball must be entirely within a teleporter
in order to trigger it.
Remember that the ball carries its momentum
through a teleporter, so plan ahead.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: gaps
levels.message:
Time the switches carefully to synchronize
the motion of the platforms.
Move quickly across the gaps.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: hallways
levels.message:
Control your speed and your bounces.
Teleporters will always bring you
back somewhere in the level.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: spiralin
levels.message:
Have fun picking up those
red and blue coins.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: spread
levels.message:
Don't worry.
The green part isn't going anywhere.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: invis
levels.message:
Allow your greed to guide you.
For an added challenge,
try to get to all of the coins.
It can be done without guesswork.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: ring
levels.message: So close, yet so very far.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: flip
levels.message:
Thus Neverball is a puzzle game?
Remove the red to unlock the goal.
Each trigger switches colors in direct contact.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: movers
levels.message: Go for a ride.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: pipe
levels.message: Ceci n'est pas une pipe.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: paths
levels.message:
So many different paths to take...
have you tried all of them?
levels.author: Paul Tompkins

levels.title: poker
levels.message: Slow and steady.
levels.author: Robert Kooima

levels.title: airways
levels.message:
2 switches have to be enabled
to open the path to the goal.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: descent
levels.message:
La descente infernale.
Easy enough to start?
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: dance1
levels.message:
La ballade tranquille.
What a quiet walk.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: drive1
levels.message:
La conduite stressante.
Attention:
The platform under the ball moves forward.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: scrambling
levels.message:
Le petit cross.
Let's go scrambling!
Stick to the track to optimize speed.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: earthquake
levels.message:
Le passage incertain.
Isn't too easy?
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: glasstower
levels.message:
La tour de verre.
Find the way to the exit.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: trust
levels.message:
Le chemin de la foi.
Self-confidence.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: loop1
levels.message:
Les boucles renversantes.
Upside down!
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: maze1
levels.message:
Le chemin dissimulé.
Test your memory.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: snow
levels.message:
La descente rafraîchissante.
Not so fast, not so fast.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: circuit1
levels.message:
La course effrénée.
Let's run some laps.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: comeback
levels.message:
Le cycle éternel.
Avoid teleporters...
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: maze2
levels.message:
Le labyrinthe fou.
You know the way, you see it,
so why are you taking another one?
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: circuit2
levels.message:
Les rampes abruptes.
Control your speed.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: ghosts
levels.message:
Ghost Valley.
Make 3 laps to open the goal.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: turn
levels.message:
Le sens trigonométrique.
Turn, wait and jump.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: assault
levels.message:
Le parcours du combattant.
Ready for the assault course?
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: narrow
levels.message:
Le sentier étroit.
Patience and timing.
Tip: maximise speed at the first slope.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: loop2
levels.message:
Le contrôle des courbes.
Find the right angle to turn,
to jump and to land...
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: up
levels.message:
L'ascension pressée.
Only one piece of advice: don't stop!
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: drive2
levels.message:
La conduite dangereuse.
The platform under the ball moves quickly forward.
You would do well to advance.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: running
levels.message:
Les épreuves minutées.
Run baby, run!
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: climb
levels.message:
L'escalade ardue.
Do you suffer from vertigo?
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: hard
levels.message:
La maîtrise de Neverball.
You still think Neverball is too easy?
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: dance2
levels.message:
La ballade dansante.
Let's dance on the moving platform!
Tip: After activating the last moving platform,
 turn around the Thwomp until the goal is reachable.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: sonic
levels.message:
Un petit échauffement.
Welcome to Mehdi's new set!
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: movinglumps
levels.message:
Être patient.
Not too hard.

levels.title: backforth
levels.message:
Un va-et-vient frustrant.
Remember the activation order.

levels.message:
Les toiles attirantes.
Get out of the webs.

levels.message:
La danse asiatique
Trust the arrows.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: translation
levels.message:
Suis le mouvement.
Warning, the road is moving.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: movingpath
levels.message:
Le passage éphémère.
Trust the coins.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: bigball
levels.message:
La machine à circonvolutions.
Easy, the goal is just above you.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: bounces
levels.message:
Les sauts du célèbre plombier.
Follow the coins.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.message:
Rainbow Road.
Do 3 laps to open the goal.

levels.title: bombman
levels.message:
Les flammes ardentes.
Does this remind you of something?

J'y vais, ou j'y vais pas ?
Do not dither.

Savoir rebondir pour aller plus haut.
The Neverball Arena.
Use the 2 teleports to unlock and reach the goal.

levels.title: updown
levels.message:
Tranquille, mais pas trop.
Sync yourself to the elevators.

levels.title: basket
levels.message:
Street Neverball
Choose your party and score 3 points.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: longpipe
levels.message:
Si si, ce tuyau a une fin.
Living in a pipe.

levels.message:
Le grand cône.
Living in a cone.

Le rodéo de Neverball.
You'll fall quickly.

Ne pas se laisser emporter dans le néant.
Don't go too low.

Préparez un petit sac.
The stomach-tester.

Hé, on pousse pas !
Not too fast, not too slow.

Le petit moulin.
The good timing to go in the cabin.

Plus vite que la vitesse.
The definition of speed.

levels.message:
Plus dur que la difficulté.
Good luck.
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.title: freefall
levels.message:
This level is full of challenges:
understand the level's functioning,
learn to fly and to survive,
grab half of all coins to open the goal,
find and reach the goal,
and more...
levels.author: Mehdi Yousfi-Monod

levels.message:
=Atrium=

=Swarm=

=Tennis=
There is plenty of prize money, and it's up for grabs.

=Oddities=
Something is not quite right here...

=Tree=
